threads.author: @vazzyweb3

threads.our_reply: This is where better data presentation really matters: once tokenized assets are easy to compare, filter, and contextualize, the market becomes much more usable. Discovery infrastructure ends up doing a lot of the heavy lifting.

threads.author: @bjeshp
threads.topic: Affirm Bitcoin-native growth, then add that durable adoption comes from real creator/app primitives on Bitcoin L2s, not just financial narratives.
threads.our_reply: Agree the shift is bigger than the old digital gold frame. The durable part is what gets built on top: creator tools, permanent media, and app primitives that give Bitcoin L2s real everyday use beyond pure financial flow.

threads.author: @leojansens
threads.topic: Agree that Bitcoin can stay minimal at base layer while L2s handle richer app layers; note that creator and data use cases matter alongside finance.
threads.our_reply: That separation makes sense. Keep Bitcoin simple at the base, let L2s handle richer logic. I’d just add that creator and data use cases matter too, not only finance, because they give the stack reasons to be used outside trading cycles.

threads.author: @agratefulape
threads.topic: Answer that fee security debates become stronger when L2 usage reflects real demand from applications, creators, and data-heavy use cases rather than only trading.
threads.our_reply: My view is fee security arguments get stronger when L2 usage comes from real demand, not just trading bursts. If apps, media and creator tooling keep generating transactions over time, that’s a healthier signal than macro models alone.
